name: cannibal.r_caol_first_smoke_terrain_scout_013_forest_dominant

steps.label: load_clean_forest_dominant_owner_copy

Check exact effective userdir, byte hashes, same-run native World and starting turn, safe mode Off, no pending input, no fire/smoke, no cannibal site knowledge or outing. steps.label: natural_forest_scavenge_after_smoke_admission
steps.objective: From the clean closed-window forest-dominant profile, verify native World/start state and source binding. Use the accepted ordinary ground-floor brazier smoke procedure to admit/materialize the normal cannibal roster; wait in short real native intervals until actual fd_smoke and a production_signal_materialization event expose the concrete actor IDs. Extinguish with native Examine and verify fd_fire plus all intended smoke/signal sources have ended before the signal-off routine observation. Allow natural 60-minute terrain scan/candidate selection. Follow every selected same-ID actor through real route positions, physical forest tile/watch observation and actual scavenging/inventory/haul if it occurs, then return/report. No inserted leads, site knowledge, outing, target, report, route, dispatch, clairvoyance or synthetic signal. Do not repeat identical non-forest cycles; stop at the first informative non-forest trip/rejection if forest is not selected.
proof_targets: bind effective relative profile, source/executable, World, initial turn, safe mode Off, pending input, and unlit/no-smoke/no-prior-cannibal-knowledge premises
record the ordinary brazier source, actual smoke packet/range, exact production_signal_materialization event, and concrete actor IDs
use ordinary native Examine to extinguish; verify fd_fire and all residual signal fields have ended before counting signal-off behavior
observe natural production scan over the 11 forest/1 field terrain geometry; record lead candidates/statuses and normal candidate/route ranking
if forest scavenge dispatches, prove same-ID physical position/action at the target/watch, actual item/cargo/haul delta, safe return and identity/generation-bound report
if a non-forest job wins or no dispatch occurs, capture exact eligibility/ranking/rejection and stop at that informative boundary; do not cycle identical trips
save meaningful native turns, actor metadata, simulation timing, and gracefully exit all owned processes with PID/birth checks
invariants: clean disposable owner-archive copy; preserve all R012/R013 prior profiles and evidence
only setup difference in save files is translated cannibal camp overmap footprint; no inserted live-world knowledge, leads, actors, outings, reports, dispatches, routes, or targets

evidence_contract.claim: A smoke-admitted natural cannibal roster on a separately staged forest-dominant terrain layout can physically scout and scavenge a reachable nearby forest bounty, return its goods, and report through native source and actor identity. Signal admission and prior site knowledge remain distinct from the later signal-off terrain behavior.
evidence_contract.failure_rule: Verify the byte-exact archive and sole overmap footprint placement change; in World verify initial state and normal signal admission/materialization with concrete actors. Turn the source off using native interaction and verify all signals absent. Observe natural terrain scanning and one informative scheduler/cycle boundary. Physical scavenge credit requires same-ID route/action/tile evidence and an actual inventory/haul delta, followed by return/report. Preserve a non-forest winner or exact source eligibility/rejection as the first boundary, and do not force or repeat identical outings.
